speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling on your palms; can you tell me how long you have noticed these symptoms and what they look like?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Versicolor (Tinea Versicolor). The combination of a longstanding itchy rash on the upper body/face, palm paresthesia, and exposure to livestock/rice farming suggests a fungal infection. Requesting a Wood's lamp examination and skin scraping for KOH would confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Scraping_KOH; REQUEST TEST: Wood_Lamp_Examination.
